description:
Problem and construction: Initialize a pheromone matrix from a nearest-neighbor tour. Multiple ants construct TSP tours using pheromone and distance, with local pheromone updates on traversed edges.

Iteration: Compare ant tours with the best cost; on even iterations improve the best ant with 2.5-opt, and on odd iterations improve a random ant with 2-opt. Update the global best when the resulting cost is strictly smaller, then reinforce its edges. Stop on the recorded best-known cost, the iteration limit, or the approximate time bound.

Boundary: The best route vector starts as all zeros while its cost starts at the nearest-neighbor cost. If no ant or locally improved tour strictly improves that cost, the reinforced edges and any printed route may not represent the nearest-neighbor tour. The function returns the best length, not the route; it prints the route only when print_path is enabled. Independently validate any printed tour; the initial known cost alone is insufficient.
